notes.title: 1.04 Patch (Oculus VR + Motion controller support)
notes.notes:
- VR support + motion controllers
- Battery recharge mechanic now automatic
- Improved cut scenes (still the same, just some more tweaks / polish)
- Fixed snow not showing when looking down during build a snowman

notes.title: 1.02 + 1.03 Nightmare Night Patch!
notes.notes:
Content:
- Nightmare night added.
- Mystery door.

Bugs:
- Fixed physics items pushing player around.
- Fixed door sometimes not interacting to close
- Green snowman now slows down when hit
- Fixed multi door entrances not firing
- Hand cross-hair revealed during bedroom prep to make it easier to pick up items.

 Barry
